story: hey2, 2026-11-12. #1859's first build flaked, the same tree passed when built again, and #1859 was built once more to land. #1755 was queued while that last build ran. The queue merged it onto the build of #1859 that had failed, not the one running, so when #1859 landed #1755's build stood on a commit the trunk never held: it was thrown away 22 minutes in and begun again. A pull request queued behind a build that was begun again is built on that build.
